runtime_integration: 356/356 creative assets provisionally integrated under game/assets. Player idle/walk and idle/move SpriteFrames for all nine common enemy roles, the elite prototype and both boss roles play from simulation time. Attack frames play during shooter/exploder fuses and boss telegraph/charge phases. Boss special animations now play for Warden charges and Core spiral/combined abilities. All projectile sprite roles now loop their authored SpriteFrames while retaining movement rotation, trails and per-instance tint. All 20 base/evolved weapon attack sheets and 20 family fire/impact sheets are loaded; attack and fire VFX play on successful shots, and animated impacts replace the static impact when available. The 64-entry transient animation cap bounds dense fire and impact scenes. XP collection plays its authored four-frame animation after orb despawn; world reward chests and newly acquired relics play their authored reveal animations, including while the choice UI pauses simulation. Death animations survive ECS despawn and play for their metadata-defined duration. Generated SFX families and menu/result/adaptive music remain connected. Signal Prism now renders in the launch menu and NeonArcadeUI is the shared theme font. Human visual and auditory review remains pending. Two reference mixes without runtime consumers were retired from game/assets; their local generation recipes still emit staging-only previews. Each of ten weapons now has four deterministic fire variations and four impact variations; SfxService rotates the four files for each frequent event.
artistic_review: Internal pixel-level review corrected a four-direction orientation defect in the player sheets. The static catalog remains geometric and non-player animation is still procedural role work; these are provisionally integrated prototypes, not a human-approved production art pass. A redesigned batch of 31 role-specific weapon/evolution/relic catalog icons passed palette, dimensions, color-count, source/export hash, and Godot smoke checks and replaced only those explicitly authorized managed IDs. Catalog readability and the provisional shapes/colors still need owner review. A technical audit found that the generated SpriteFrames resources stored atlas regions as unsupported frame fields, so Godot treated full sheets as every frame. All 131 animation resources now use per-frame AtlasTexture subresources and pass a manifest-driven Godot smoke; boss/elite animation sheets were regenerated at native 96x96/24x24 cel dimensions. Runtime now plays idle/move frames for all 12 enemy/elite/boss roles from simulation time, plus attack frames during shooter/exploder fuses and boss telegraph/charge phases. Boss special sheets now play during Warden charges and Core spiral/combined attacks. All weapon attack/fire/impact animation sheets are now connected to their corresponding successful-fire and direct-hit events; XP collection, chest-open and relic-acquisition animations are connected; projectile loop animation is connected using existing frames; death cadence follows authored provisional metadata. Human art review remains pending.
